title: Ashbury Rewards Guidance on the Relocation Booking-Value Supplement
content:
A relocated Ashbury Rewards reservation of high room value carries a booking-value supplement in points, added to the relocation compensation of that reservation.

## Rule

The room value of the relocated reservation is its nightly rate times its nights booked, both read from its Room Reservations record; a room value of one thousand US dollars or more carries a relocation booking-value supplement of seven thousand five hundred points, a room value from five hundred dollars up to but not including one thousand dollars carries two thousand five hundred points, and a lower room value carries none.

| Room value of the relocated reservation | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 USD or more | 7500 points |
| 500.00 USD up to but not including 1000.00 USD | 2500 points |
| Below 500.00 USD | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical reservations)

| Nightly rate | Nights booked | Room value | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 250.00 USD | 4 | 1000.00 USD | 7500 points |
| 333.33 USD | 3 | 999.99 USD | 2500 points |
| 250.00 USD | 2 | 500.00 USD | 2500 points |
| 166.66 USD | 3 | 499.98 USD | None |

The nightly rate is the room rate per night before tax, so the room value takes no tax into account.
